WorkspaceList.note: A repo group's five workspaces with PR dots anchored on the leading git glyph (open/checks_failing/pending/merged) and a plain branch row with no PR. Selected row and trailing times both read.

ActivityAndUnread.note: Trailing-cell precedence demonstrated in one column: spinner, waiting, error, unread dot, then a plain time on an archived (muted) row.

SubtitleRows.note: 40px subtitle rows carrying the branch under the workspace name, including one branch long enough to truncate.

ShortcutAndHoverAction.note: shortcutLabel + shortcutRevealVisible on two rows, and the hover-revealed row menu on the third (focus-on-mount). The menu glyph is ~10.5px on purpose — SidebarActionButton overrides the base primitive's icon size.
